scope: Only the exact S74 source, contract and small accepted S72 metadata read. Stdlib compile and static metadata checks only. No scientific coordinate/NPZ/image/weight body, numerical experiment or model/import execution. Existing S72 original-camera/K and correct-residual validation is reused, not repeated in source review.
runtime_boundary: The lexical absolute venv string must be passed without resolving its symlink. The actual external command/30-second limit and returned evidence are future observations. Source PASS does not mean the control separated labels or the all-four event passed.
limitations: F separation is dimensionless in the fixed pixel coordinates, not camera-pose distance or pixel residual. Equivalent scale/sign geometries remain uninformative.
Saved correct residuals are reused as requested; their independent rederivation and all new wrong-residual/statistic checks occur after the actual run.
No invalid point becomes zero error. Fractions-of-matches use M while fractions-of-valid use V; anchor availability uses M/N.

A positive event establishes sensitivity to this one chosen permutation on selected same-scene matches only. It cannot certify calibration, correspondence truth, achieved generated poses, S70 failure cause or a novel method.
A caught failure preserves geometry_separation and previously appended pairs; external hard stop may leave a partial namespace.
